risk_flags.description: The promised test checks the grand total and presence of TOTAL, but it does not commit to verifying that each category subtotal is correct. That matters because the request specifically asks for the year report to have the same per-category breakdown as the monthly report.
risk_flags.span: with the same per-category breakdown the monthly report gives

risk_flags.description: The contract declares the combined `--year` and `--month` interaction unsupported, which may be fine, but it should be made explicit whether the CLI should reject that combination rather than silently choosing one. An unsupported interaction that merely does not crash can still produce confusing or misleading reports.
risk_flags.span: using both is unsupported but at minimum does not crash

risk_flags.description: The test plan includes a very specific expected total before implementation work has begun. If that number is guessed or tied too narrowly to current fixture details, the test may assert the wrong behavior instead of the requirement.

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the new test may not actually verify the required per-category yearly breakdown.
